Is Meilisearch a European company?

Yes. Meilisearch is developed by Meili SAS, a company incorporated under French law with its registered office in Paris, France (RCS Paris 844 156 364). The company was founded in Paris and most of the team works across Europe.

You choose the region when you create a project. Projects created in Paris (PAR) or Frankfurt (FRA) store their documents, indexes, and backups in the European Union. We also offer London (LON) for UK data residency.
Is Meilisearch GDPR compliant?

Yes. Meilisearch acts as a data processor for the data you index and signs a Data Processing Agreement with customers. Combined with an EU region, you keep personal data inside the European Union. You can delete documents at any time through the API to honor erasure requests.
Can I self-host Meilisearch in Europe?

Yes. Meilisearch is open source under the MIT license. You can run it on any European cloud provider, in your own data center, or in an air-gapped environment. Enterprise licenses add dedicated support and enterprise features for self-hosted deployments.
Meilisearch Cloud is SOC 2 Type II certified. Our security documentation, including the SOC 2 report under NDA, is available from our Trust Center.
Can I use AI search features without sending data outside the EU?
Yes. Meilisearch lets you bring your own embedder through a REST configuration, so you can use a European AI provider or a model you host yourself in the EU for hybrid and semantic search.

Meilisearch Cloud is available in nine regions. Choosing the right region is one of the most impactful decisions for search latency: network round-trip time between your users and the Meilisearch instance is typically the largest contributor to perceived search speed.

Minimize latency for your users. A search that takes 5 ms to execute on the server can feel instant or sluggish depending on whether the user is 10 ms or 200 ms away. Choose the region closest to the majority of your users.

Consider data residency requirements. If your application handles personal data subject to GDPR or other regional regulations, ensure your project is hosted in a compliant region. FRA and PAR are located in the EU, while LON is located in the UK. For workloads with strict European data sovereignty requirements, PAR runs on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.

Minimize your carbon footprint. Regions differ in the carbon intensity of their local power grid. PAR is a low-carbon region thanks to France’s largely low-emission electricity mix. See carbon footprint for more on how region choice affects emissions.

Plan for multiple regions if you have a global audience. You can create separate projects per region and route search traffic to the nearest instance from your application layer. Each project accrues its own charges, billed together at the team or organization level.
Regions cannot be changed after a project is created. To move to a different region, create a new project in the target region and re-index your documents.
The list of available regions grows over time. If none of the current regions fit your requirements (latency, data residency, or compliance), contact support@meilisearch.com to request a new one.

For Enterprise workloads that require data to be replicated across multiple regions (for disaster recovery, global low-latency search, or compliance), Meilisearch supports multi-region replication. This is an Enterprise feature that requires dedicated infrastructure setup. Contact sales@meilisearch.com to discuss your requirements.
